name: Archmage Leryda
summary: Archmage Leryda is a Kirin Tor sorceress and senior operative of the Violet Eye stationed outside the haunted tower of Karazhan. Working alongside Archmage Alturus, she monitors the supernatural anomalies stirring within Medivh's abandoned estate and enlists capable adventurers to delve into its depths.

sections.title: Watcher of the Tower
sections.body: Perched at the threshold of Karazhan in the blighted expanse of Deadwind Pass, Archmage Leryda represents the watchful gaze of Dalaran. The Violet Eye—a covert sect of the Kirin Tor dedicated exclusively to observing Karazhan and the legacy of the Last Guardian—maintains a constant post here. While the tower has long been shuttered, sinister energies and restless spirits have begun to pulse from its halls once more. Leryda acts as a primary liaison for those venturing into the spire, outfitting brave champions with specialized signets that channel the power and discipline of the Violet Eye across various combat paths.

faq.answer: Archmage Leryda is an archmage of Dalaran and a ranking member of the Violet Eye stationed outside Karazhan in Deadwind Pass.
The Violet Eye is a secretive order formed by the Kirin Tor specifically tasked with surveilling Medivh, his tower of Karazhan, and the dangerous magical fallout left in the wake of his demise.

faq.q: Why is she standing outside Karazhan?
faq.answer: Leryda observes the dark energies stirring inside the abandoned tower, assisting expeditionary forces and recognizing the achievements of those who combat the threats within Karazhan.

faq.q: What are the rings she offers?
faq.answer: She bestows the Violet Signet to adventurers aligned with the Violet Eye. These enchanted rings honor martial disciplines such as the assassin, protector, restorer, or mage, growing in power as a hero earns greater standing with the order.

angles.text: As a Kirin Tor archmage, Leryda respects fellow practitioners of the arcane who possess the courage to confront the unstable remnants of the Guardian's grand magic.
